motivated_seller.label: Motivated seller (cash offer)
motivated_seller.goal: Find owners who want to sell quickly and as-is, and qualify them before the lead is sold, so the buyer gets a better lead-to-deal ratio.

required_question_topics.why: How soon they need to sell separates motivated sellers from browsers.
Repairs needed is the main reason to accept an as-is cash offer.
A property already listed on the MLS is usually not an off-market deal.
Only the owner on the title (or all owners) can sign.
Inheritance, relocation, tired landlord or financial pressure predict a deal.

roofing.label: Roof replacement
roofing.goal: Find homeowners who need a full roof replacement, not a minor repair, and qualify them before the lead is sold.

required_question_topics.why: Only the owner can approve a replacement.
Roofs over 15 to 20 years old are replacement candidates.
Storm damage over large areas points to replacement; a single leak points to repair.
Separates replacement leads (high value) from repair leads.
An open or approved claim changes timing and budget.
